implementation_boundary.proposed_public_header:
theorem n04_referenceCurrent_transport_piece_envelope
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {K : CanonicalData S}
    {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hrefState : referenceStateConditions D S C)
    (hgeom : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (href : CanonicalGeometry.ReferenceJets D T S C L K)
    (hcur : CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L K base ε)
    (z : CanonicalGeometry.Parameter S) (hz : z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε) :
    ∃ e : ℕ → ℝ, N07aSampleSubpower T K e ∧ (∀ m, 1 ≤ e m) ∧
      ∀ m p, p ∈ referencePhysicalPieceOpen S K m →
        (∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2 →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
            (fun x => K.height (C.referenceState, 0) m x /
              K.height (liftSectorParameter S C z) m
                (canonicalCurrentPoint C K (liftSectorParameter S C z) m x)) p‖ ≤ e m) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ 2 →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
            (canonicalCurrentPoint C K (liftSectorParameter S C z) m) p‖ ≤ e m)
implementation_boundary.header_status: Precise planned interface, not a declaration claimed to exist or to elaborate.
implementation_boundary.explicit_inputs: The original D,T,S,C,L,K and actual ReferenceJets, CurrentJets, CanonicalGeometry are preserved. referenceStateConditions and ε>0 supply the genuine reference membership/sector facts. The state is fixed before the sampled envelope is chosen.
no_inputs: a state-dependent current physical piece identified with a fixed reference rectangle
implementation_boundary.output_scope: Only ordinary spatial jets on each reference open physical piece: q orders0..2 and τ orders1..2, one sampled envelope e_z≥1 uniform in all pieces and points. No zeroth-order bound on the unbounded angular coordinate of τ is asserted.
implementation_boundary.parent_owned_followup: Root owns same-sample M absorption, actual global τ/q identification and AE44 extension, H/M ratios, and the common final C0,A=1 packaging.

actual_functions.R: n07aCanonicalAtomField D T S C L K .sourceFactorInverse z m
actual_functions.T: canonicalCurrentPoint C K (liftSectorParameter S C z) m = G ∘ F
actual_functions.Q: fun p => H p / K.height (liftSectorParameter S C z) m (G (F p))
actual_functions.density_identity: On V: (K.height current m (G y))⁻¹ = R y * |planeJacobian G y|. Consequently on W: Q = H * ((R * |planeJacobian G|) ∘ F).
actual_functions.exact_domain_proof: hgeom.charts at reference, rewritten by hgeom.referenceDomain, maps F from W into V. hgeom.charts at the actual lifted z maps G from V into physicalPieceOpen at that z. The latter is not generally W.

order_table.field: planeJacobian G and its absolute value
order_table.source: n07a_planeJacobian_fixedEnvelope_of_positiveJets and .abs; one extra derivative of G
R times absolute inverse Jacobian, actual local nonzero sign

shortest_sequence.action: Recover reference smoothness and forward/height envelopes directly.
shortest_sequence.details: Use hgeom.referenceBounds and reference_mem_stateNeighborhood hε; hrefState.stateSector supplies the reference sector. The i=2 physical field is literally H. n07a_referencePhysicalJetFields_fixedEnvelope supplies all six raw physical fields; n07a_physicalChart_positive_fixedEnvelope reconstructs F from i=0,1. No state-zero invocation of CurrentJets is needed.

shortest_sequence.action: Specialize the existing genuine inverse-chart estimate at fixed z.
shortest_sequence.details: Call n07a_inverseChart_positive_jets with hgeom.referenceBounds. For each positive n multiply its sampled e_n by the finite scalar 1+parameterGrading S ((n−1)+loss) z using N07aSampleSubpower.const/mul. This scalar is chosen after z and n, before m and points.

shortest_sequence.action: Produce the canonical current-height reciprocal from actual source and inverse Jacobian.
shortest_sequence.details: hgeom.charts gives G smooth on V and nonzero inverse Jacobian via n07a_actual_inverseChart_jacobian_abs. Call n07a_planeJacobian_fixedEnvelope_of_positiveJets, then the existing .abs lemma. Obtain R's canonical-envelope/smoothness from the actual .sourceFactorInverse atom. Multiply them using existing .mul. Prove the density identity with hgeom.charts, the true source definition and n07aCanonicalUnitPoint_inverse, copying only the algebra of the existing h04 wrapper with hgeom replacing h04.1. Include ContDiffOn of the reciprocal in the private result, from positive height and G MapsTo.

shortest_sequence.action: Compose and multiply to obtain the literal Q.
shortest_sequence.details: Existing N07aAngularFixedJetEnvelope.comp allows arbitrary inner positive jets but includes outer order0, which is available for the reciprocal height. Compose with F, multiply by H, and use an explicit full-function equality or EqOn/congr to reach the literal division Q. No partial-function simp inference is needed.

shortest_sequence.action: Compose only positive G jets with positive F jets to obtain literal T.
shortest_sequence.details: A short private variant of the existing comp proof runs only at n>0. For each OrderedFinpartition n, k.length_pos hn and k.partSize_pos ensure every requested G and F jet is positive. Use the public norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le_partition_sum and finite products/sums of N07aSampleSubpower. This avoids any requirement to bound G at order0.

shortest_sequence.action: Choose a single finite envelope for both fields.
shortest_sequence.details: From Q orders indexed by Fin3 and T orders j+1 indexed by Fin2, set e(m)=1+Σq_i(m)+Σt_j(m). Existing const, add and finset_sum preserve N07aSampleSubpower, positivity gives e≥1, and single_le_sum supplies each order. Choice is after fixed z but before every m,p,n in the displayed output.

actual_cost_accounting.reference_physical_affine: N07aAngularPhysicalJetEnvelopes pulls the physical unit atom back using λ_m=physicalRight−physicalLeft. A radial derivative of order a costs λ_m^(-a), an angular derivative costs1, and mixed-to-Fréchet costs2^n. ReferenceJets .physicalLengthInverse pays λ_m⁻¹.
actual_cost_accounting.reference_forward_pair: F=(left+ρ*chartRadial, θ+chartAngleDefect), ρ=right−left. ReferenceJets .canonicalLength pays |ρ|; the angular identity contributes1 only at positive orders.
actual_cost_accounting.current_canonical_affine: N07aCanonicalAtomBounds pulls unit atoms back by the canonical inverse affine, paying ρ_m^(-a). ReferenceJets .canonicalLengthInverse pays that cost.
actual_cost_accounting.current_inverse_pair: G=(physicalLeft+λ*inverseRadial, θ+inverseAngleDefect); ReferenceJets .physicalLength pays |λ|. No radial zero-order or absolute angular bound is introduced.
actual_cost_accounting.source_and_sample: All raw atom bounds, affine lengths and envelopes retain exactly K.cell m and T.sample(K.cell m). No endpoint or opposite-half sample is substituted.
actual_cost_accounting.determinant: Plane determinant uses two first derivative columns of G; differentiating twice needs G through order3. Absolute value is locally equal to ±the determinant at a nonzero value, so no quantitative determinant lower bound or reciprocal determinant cost is added.
actual_cost_accounting.state_factor: Only fixed-z finite scalar grading factors enter envelope constants; no new uniform low-base theorem is asserted in this stage.
actual_cost_accounting.H_gain: Existing absolute-atom suppliers already perform their documented same-sample gain absorption. This leaf does not infer any new endpoint H lower bound or assume E0≥1.
